But thinking these exercises could help rescuers [48] real situations calmly made all the difference.

questions.explanation: 根据后文的 showing bandage techniques (展示绷带包扎技术) 可知，作者扮演的是接受包扎的“病人”(patient)。doctor 医生，scholar 学者，fireman 消防员均不符合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(doctor)：语境句：The doctor advised him to get plenty of rest. 固定搭配：see a doctor, family doctor
B(patient)：语境句：The nurse is very patient with the elderly patient. 固定搭配：treat a patient, patient care
C(scholar)：语境句：He is a visiting scholar at the university. 固定搭配：an outstanding scholar, a visiting scholar
D(fireman)：语境句：The brave fireman rescued a child from the burning building. 固定搭配：call the fireman, volunteer fireman

questions.explanation: 作者当时并不知道这个简单的决定会“塑造/改变”(shape)他的一生。后文详细描述了这次经历如何让他开启了长达数十年的志愿服务。pause 暂停，destroy 破坏，simplify 简化。
questions.supplement:
A(shape)：语境句：Our early experiences help shape our personalities. 固定搭配：shape one's life, shape the future
B(pause)：语境句：She paused for a moment to consider her answer. 固定搭配：pause for breath, without a pause
C(destroy)：语境句：The earthquake destroyed many buildings in the city. 固定搭配：destroy completely, destroy the environment
D(simplify)：语境句：We need to simplify the instructions so everyone can understand. 固定搭配：simplify the process, simplify a problem

questions.explanation: 回到伦敦后，作者“加入”(joined)了一个模拟突发事件的志愿者小组。discover 发现，sponsor 赞助，found 创立(作者只是参与者，并非创始人)。
questions.supplement:
A(discovered)：语境句：Scientists have discovered a new species of plant. 固定搭配：discover the truth, make a discovery
B(joined)：语境句：She joined the club to meet new people. 固定搭配：join a club, join hands
C(sponsored)：语境句：The sports event was sponsored by a local company. 固定搭配：sponsor an event, officially sponsored
D(founded)：语境句：The organization was founded in 1998. 固定搭配：found a company, newly founded

questions.explanation: 结合后文的 pretending to have injuries (假装受伤) 以及 a car accident，可知他们在模拟“事故”(accidents) 中度过数小时。operation 手术/行动，image 图像，model 模型。
questions.supplement:
A(operations)：语境句：The doctor performed three operations today. 固定搭配：rescue operations, military operations
B(images)：语境句：The satellite sent back high-resolution images of the earth. 固定搭配：vivid images, public image
C(accidents)：语境句：Traffic accidents are common on this busy road. 固定搭配：car accident, by accident
D(models)：语境句：The architect built a scale model of the new museum. 固定搭配：role model, fashion model

questions.explanation: 作者假装受伤，而救援人员则在“练习”(practiced) 安全救援技能。instruct 指导，compare 比较，update 更新。
questions.supplement:
A(practiced)：语境句：She practiced playing the piano for two hours every day. 固定搭配：practice skills, put into practice
B(instructed)：语境句：The teacher instructed the students to open their books. 固定搭配：instruct somebody to do, strictly instructed
C(compared)：语境句：He compared the two products before making a purchase. 固定搭配：compare A with B, compared to/with
D(updated)：语境句：Please ensure your software is fully updated. 固定搭配：update the system, an updated version

questions.explanation: 前文提到 a car accident (车祸)，所以火焰是从“车辆”(vehicle) 底部喷出来的。vehicle 是对 car 的同义替换。roof 车顶，ground 地面，window 窗户。
questions.supplement:
A(roof)：语境句：The rain was leaking through the roof. 固定搭配：on the roof, a roof over one's head
B(ground)：语境句：The leaves fell softly to the ground. 固定搭配：on the ground, common ground
C(vehicle)：语境句：Electric vehicles are becoming more and more popular. 固定搭配：motor vehicle, commercial vehicle
D(window)：语境句：She looked out the window and sighed. 固定搭配：look out the window, window shopping

questions.explanation: 破折号后解释“那是一场如此真实的火”，虽然知道是安全的，但作者还是忍不住“发抖”(shaking)。complain 抱怨，jump 跳跃，laugh 大笑。
questions.supplement:
A(complaining)：语境句：Customers are complaining about the poor service. 固定搭配：complain about, complain to somebody
B(jumping)：语境句：The kids were jumping up and down with excitement. 固定搭配：jump for joy, jump to conclusions
C(laughing)：语境句：They couldn't stop laughing at the joke. 固定搭配：laugh at, burst out laughing
D(shaking)：语境句：He was shaking with cold after falling into the river. 固定搭配：shake hands, shaking with fear

questions.explanation: 想到这些演习能帮助救援人员冷静地“处理/应对”(handle)真实情况，一切都值得了。observe 观察，predict 预测，explain 解释。
questions.supplement:
A(observe)：语境句：Scientists observe the behavior of wild animals. 固定搭配：observe carefully, observe the law
B(handle)：语境句：She knows how to handle difficult customers gracefully. 固定搭配：handle a situation, handle stress
C(predict)：语境句：It is hard to predict the weather accurately. 固定搭配：predict the future, difficult to predict
D(explain)：语境句：Can you explain how this machine works? 固定搭配：explain to somebody, explain in detail

questions.explanation: 根据后文“这个年轻人在现实中救了自己祖父一命”可知，这次演习对作者来说是最“有回报的/有意义的”(rewarding)。entertaining 娱乐的，challenging 具有挑战性的，exhausting 令人精疲力尽的。
questions.supplement:
A(rewarding)：语境句：Teaching is a highly rewarding profession. 固定搭配：a rewarding experience, financially rewarding
B(entertaining)：语境句：The movie was very entertaining and funny. 固定搭配：an entertaining speech, highly entertaining
C(challenging)：语境句：This task is challenging but entirely possible. 固定搭配：a challenging job, face a challenging situation
D(exhausting)：语境句：After an exhausting day at work, he fell asleep on the sofa. 固定搭配：an exhausting journey, physically exhausting

questions.explanation: 三周后，年轻人“追踪/找到了”(tracked)作者来道谢。track down 是固定短语，意为“追踪找到”。knock 敲门，turn 转向，calm 平静。
questions.supplement:
A(knocked)：语境句：Someone knocked at the door late at night. 固定搭配：knock down, knock out
B(turned)：语境句：He turned around and walked away. 固定搭配：turn out, turn down
C(calmed)：语境句：The mother calmed the crying baby. 固定搭配：calm down, keep calm
D(tracked)：语境句：The police finally tracked down the suspect. 固定搭配：track down, keep track of

questions.explanation: 超过1000次的被救经历，为作者“赢得”(earning)了“真人碰撞测试员”的称号。earn sb. a name 为某人赢得名声。pick 挑选，display 展示，owe 欠/归功于。
questions.supplement:
A(earning)：语境句：His hard work earned him a promotion. 固定搭配：earn a living, earn a reputation
B(picking)：语境句：She is picking flowers in the garden. 固定搭配：pick up, pick out
C(displaying)：语境句：The museum is displaying a new collection of art. 固定搭配：on display, display a talent
D(owing)：语境句：Owing to the bad weather, the flight was cancelled. 固定搭配：owe A to B, owing to

questions.explanation: 作者喜欢把自己多年的经验“传递”(pass on)给新志愿者。turn over 翻转/移交，give away 泄露/赠送，bring up 抚养/提出。
questions.supplement:
A(turn over)：语境句：Please turn over the page and read the next chapter. 固定搭配：turn over a new leaf, turn over to
B(give away)：语境句：He gave away all his books to the local library. 固定搭配：give away a secret, give away free tickets
C(pass on)：语境句：I will pass on your message to him. 固定搭配：pass on knowledge, pass on to the next generation
D(bring up)：语境句：She brought up three children on her own. 固定搭配：bring up a topic, bring up children

questions.explanation: 结合前文可知，模拟事故中有真火等危险场景，新志愿者最初很难掩饰他们的“恐慌”(panic)。disappointment 失望，regret 遗憾，doubt 怀疑。
questions.supplement:
A(disappointment)：语境句：To my great disappointment, they lost the game. 固定搭配：hide one's disappointment, a deep disappointment
B(regret)：语境句：He expressed deep regret for his mistakes. 固定搭配：with regret, express regret
C(doubt)：语境句：There is no doubt that he is the best player in the team. 固定搭配：without a doubt, in doubt
D(panic)：语境句：Don't panic in case of a fire. 固定搭配：in a panic, panic attack

questions.explanation: 只要身体允许，作者就会继续钻进车里。他不认为年龄是“退出/放弃”(quit)的理由。improve 改善，fail 失败，explore 探索。
questions.supplement:
A(improve)：语境句：Reading can improve your vocabulary. 固定搭配：improve quality, room to improve
B(fail)：语境句：He failed the driving test three times. 固定搭配：fail to do, without fail
C(quit)：语境句：She decided to quit her job and travel the world. 固定搭配：quit smoking, quit school
D(explore)：语境句：We will explore the island tomorrow. 固定搭配：explore the universe, explore new possibilities

questions.explanation: 呼应文章第一句 I've always been adventurous。正是这种“冒险精神/奇遇”(adventure)让他保持年轻。lesson 教训，chance 机会，tradition 传统。
questions.supplement:
A(lesson)：语境句：He learned a hard lesson from his failure. 固定搭配：learn a lesson, teach someone a lesson
B(adventure)：语境句：Her life is full of exciting adventures. 固定搭配：a sense of adventure, go on an adventure
C(chance)：语境句：Everyone deserves a second chance. 固定搭配：take a chance, by chance
D(tradition)：语境句：We celebrate the festival according to local tradition. 固定搭配：keep up a tradition, break with tradition

vocab_pack.definition_en: willing to take risks or try new things
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词作表语，描述主语特征，原形即可。
vocab_pack.example_en: My adventurous spirit led me to explore the Amazon rainforest.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我的冒险精神驱使我探索亚马逊雨林。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I've always been adventurous.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to agree to take part in something; to enroll
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去式 signed up for，用于一般过去时，主语 I。
vocab_pack.example_en: Many students signed up for the English competition.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多学生报名参加了英语竞赛。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I signed up for a free first-aid course

vocab_pack.definition_en: a training course on basic medical care for injuries
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，作宾语，单数形式。first-aid 为复合形容词。
vocab_pack.example_en: She took a first-aid course last summer.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她去年夏天参加了一个急救课程。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a free first-aid course

vocab_pack.definition_en: to perform the role or function of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词 acting as，作状语，表示目的或方式。
vocab_pack.example_en: He acted as a translator during the meeting.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他在会议中充当翻译。
vocab_pack.from_passage: by acting as a patient

vocab_pack.definition_en: used to say that someone did not realize something important
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 固定倒装结构，little 置于句首，主谓语部分倒装。原句为一般过去时。
vocab_pack.example_en: Little did I know that this job would change my life.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我当时毫不知道这份工作会改变我的一生。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Little did I know this simple decision would shape my life.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have a significant influence on someone's life
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 塑造某人的生活；对某人生有重大影响
vocab_pack.grammar_note: would shape 为过去将来时，情态动词 would 后接动词原形。
vocab_pack.example_en: The accident shaped his life forever.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那场事故永远改变了他的人生。
vocab_pack.from_passage: would shape my life

vocab_pack.definition_en: in or to one's own home or country
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 固定短语作地点状语，单独使用。
vocab_pack.example_en: Back home, we celebrate the festival with a big dinner.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 在家乡，我们以丰盛晚餐庆祝节日。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Back home in London

vocab_pack.definition_en: a group of people who work voluntarily
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，作宾语，单数形式。
vocab_pack.example_en: She joined a volunteer group to help the homeless.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她加入了一个帮助无家可归者的志愿者团体。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I joined a volunteer group simulating emergencies.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to imitate or represent the conditions of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词 simulating 作宾语补足语或定语，修饰 volunteer group。
vocab_pack.example_en: The computer program simulates a real emergency.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个计算机程序模拟真实紧急情况。
vocab_pack.from_passage: simulating emergencies

vocab_pack.definition_en: to behave as if something is true when it is not
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词 pretending 作状语，表示伴随动作。
vocab_pack.example_en: The children pretended to be astronauts.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 孩子们假装成宇航员。
vocab_pack.from_passage: pretending to have injuries

vocab_pack.definition_en: people who save others from danger
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 可数名词复数，作宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The rescuers worked tirelessly to find survivors.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 救援人员不知疲倦地寻找幸存者。
vocab_pack.from_passage: while rescuers practiced safe rescue skills

vocab_pack.definition_en: to do something repeatedly to improve one's skill
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去式 practiced，用于一般过去时，主语 rescuers。美式拼写，英式常作 practised。
vocab_pack.example_en: She practices the piano every day.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她每天练习钢琴。
vocab_pack.from_passage: practiced safe rescue skills

vocab_pack.definition_en: to remove someone from a place by cutting
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 把某人从……中切割出来（救出）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: cut 过去式与原形同形，短语动词，后接宾语和介词 from。
vocab_pack.example_en: The firefighters cut the driver from the wrecked car.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 消防员将司机从失事车辆中切割出来。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Once firefighters cut me from 'a car accident'

vocab_pack.definition_en: to come out quickly and forcefully from
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词 shooting from 作定语修饰 flames，表示主动进行。
vocab_pack.example_en: Steam shot from the broken pipe.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 蒸汽从破裂的管道中喷出。
vocab_pack.from_passage: flames shooting from under the vehicle

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have a very important effect; to be crucial
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 起到重要作用；至关重要
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 固定短语，此处为过去式 made，主语为动名词短语 thinking...。
vocab_pack.example_en: A little encouragement can make all the difference to a child.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 一点鼓励对孩子来说可能至关重要。
vocab_pack.from_passage: made all the difference

vocab_pack.definition_en: giving satisfaction or a sense of achievement
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词最高级 the most rewarding，修饰 exercise。
vocab_pack.example_en: Teaching is a rewarding career.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 教学是一项有回报的职业。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The most rewarding exercise

vocab_pack.definition_en: to give cardiopulmonary resuscitation to someone
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去式 performed，用于一般过去时。CPR 为缩写。
vocab_pack.example_en: The nurse performed CPR on the patient until help arrived.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 护士对病人实施心肺复苏直到救援到来。
vocab_pack.from_passage: performed CPR on me

vocab_pack.definition_en: to find someone or something after a long search
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去式 tracked down，用于一般过去时，主语 he。
vocab_pack.example_en: The police tracked down the missing child in two days.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 警方两天内找到了失踪的孩子。
vocab_pack.from_passage: he tracked me down to thank me

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have a heart attack
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去式 suffered，一般过去时，主语 his grandfather。
vocab_pack.example_en: He suffered a heart attack while jogging.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他慢跑时心脏病发作。
vocab_pack.from_passage: his grandfather suffered a heart attack

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause someone to be called or known as something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词 earning 作结果状语，表示主动伴随。me 为间接宾语，a name 为直接宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: His bravery earned him the name 'hero'.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他的勇敢为他赢得了“英雄”的称号。
vocab_pack.from_passage: earning me a name 'real-life crash-test man'

vocab_pack.definition_en: actually happening or existing, not fictional
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复合形容词，作定语修饰 crash-test man。
vocab_pack.example_en: The movie is based on a real-life story.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这部电影基于一个真实故事。
vocab_pack.from_passage: 'real-life crash-test man'

vocab_pack.definition_en: to give something to someone; to transmit
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动词原形 pass on，用于 be able to 之后。此处为不定式。
vocab_pack.example_en: Please pass on my regards to your family.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 请代我向你的家人问好。
vocab_pack.from_passage: pass on my experience

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have difficulty doing something
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 努力做某事（但有困难）；挣扎着做
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去式 struggled，后接不定式 to hide，表示目的。
vocab_pack.example_en: He struggled to finish the work on time.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他努力按时完成工作（很吃力）。
vocab_pack.from_passage: who often struggled to hide their initial panic

vocab_pack.definition_en: the first feeling of great fear
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，作 hide 的宾语，initial 为形容词。
vocab_pack.example_en: She managed to overcome her initial panic.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她设法克服了最初的恐慌。
vocab_pack.from_passage: hide their initial panic

vocab_pack.definition_en: to continue doing something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: keep 后接动名词 being，表示持续状态。原句为将来时 will keep。
vocab_pack.example_en: Keep trying, and you will succeed.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 继续努力，你会成功的。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I'll keep being out of cars

vocab_pack.definition_en: provided that; on condition that
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 只要（引导条件状语从句）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 连词引导条件从句，从句用一般现在时表将来。
vocab_pack.example_en: You can borrow my car as long as you drive carefully.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 只要你小心驾驶，就可以借我的车。
vocab_pack.from_passage: as long as I'm physically able to climb into them

vocab_pack.definition_en: capable in terms of physical strength or health
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词短语，作表语，后接不定式 to climb。
vocab_pack.example_en: He is still physically able to run a marathon.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他身体上仍然能跑马拉松。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I'm physically able to climb into them

vocab_pack.term: any reason for someone to do something
vocab_pack.form_in_passage: any reason for me to quit
vocab_pack.definition_en: any justification for someone to stop doing something
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 某人做某事的任何理由
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，作宾语。原句为否定结构 don't think... any reason...。
vocab_pack.example_en: There is no reason for you to give up.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 你没有理由放弃。
vocab_pack.from_passage: any reason for me to quit

vocab_pack.definition_en: to stop doing something; to resign
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动词原形，用于 for me to quit 不定式短语中。
vocab_pack.example_en: He decided to quit smoking for health reasons.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他决定为了健康戒烟。
vocab_pack.from_passage: any reason for me to quit

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make someone feel or appear young
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，主语 my adventure 为第三人称单数，谓语 keeps。
vocab_pack.example_en: Laughter keeps you young.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 欢笑使人年轻。
vocab_pack.from_passage: my adventure keeps me young!

vocab_pack.definition_en: a person who acts as a test subject in simulated crashes
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 碰撞测试假人（比喻真人模拟者）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复合名词，单数形式，作表语。
vocab_pack.example_en: He is known as the human crash-test man for his volunteering.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他因志愿工作被誉为真人碰撞测试员。
vocab_pack.from_passage: 'real-life crash-test man'

section_2_word_form.passage:
Chinese audience are familiar with the pop song Little Bliss, but hearing it performed in angelic voices by a group of foreign children made the moment even [56].
This [57] by Italy's Little Choir of Antoniano at their annual New Year concert in Shanghai this January. Later, the choir's performance spread rapidly on social media, earning more than 3 million [58].
Their other performances like China in the Lights, The Same Song and Lone Warrior have all drawn attention online. Chinese listeners all crowd in, whether to enjoy their excellent performances [59] to appreciate perfect pronunciation.
For the last decade, the Little Choir of Antoniano [60] as a cultural bridge between China and Italy, bringing Italian passion to China and [61] Chinese affection back to Italy. "People in Italy generally take pride [62] the choir's trip to China and see it as an important cultural exchange," Giampaolo Cavalli, director of Antoniano, said. "I hope that we can carry on this connection and let it grow, spreading [63] through our music."
As a gift, this year, the choir also showed a new song [64] Marco Polo's Magical Journey in memory of the adventurer, [65] laid the groundwork for China-Italy friendship more than 700 years ago.

questions.explanation: 句中出现 even 修饰，且表达“让这一刻变得更加动人”，需使用形容词的比较级。
questions.supplement: 正确形(more touching)：语境句：The movie's ending was even more touching than I expected. 固定搭配：a touching story, deeply touching。原词touching其它变形：touch(v./n.), touched(adj.感动的), touchingly(adv.).

questions.explanation: 主语 This (指代歌曲演唱) 与 deliver (呈现/表演) 是被动关系，且根据时间状语 this January 可知事情发生在过去，故用一般过去时的被动语态。
knowledge_points: 一般过去时的被动语态
questions.supplement: 正确形(was delivered)：语境句：The package was delivered to my house yesterday. 固定搭配：deliver a speech, deliver a message。原词deliver其它变形：delivery(n.), deliverer(n.).

questions.explanation: 在社交媒体语境中，like 作名词意为“点赞”，前面有 3 million 修饰，故用复数形式。
questions.supplement: 正确形(likes)：语境句：Her new video got millions of likes on social media. 固定搭配：likes and dislikes, gain likes。原词like其它变形：dislike(v./n.), likely(adj./adv.), likeness(n.).

questions.explanation: 考察固定搭配 whether... or... (无论是...还是...)，连接两个不定式短语 to enjoy... 和 to appreciate...。
questions.supplement: 正确形(or)：语境句：You must decide whether you want to go or stay. 固定搭配：whether... or..., either... or...

questions.explanation: 时间状语 For the last decade (在过去的十年里) 通常与现在完成时连用，表示动作从过去持续到现在，且主语为单数名词短语，用 has served（has been serving 亦可）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(has served)：语境句：He has served in the army for ten years. 固定搭配：serve as, serve the public。原词serve其它变形：service(n.), servant(n.), serving(n.).

questions.explanation: and 连接两个并列成分，与前面的 bringing 保持形式一致，作结果状语或伴随状语，使用现在分词形式。
questions.supplement: 正确形(carrying)：语境句：She walked in, carrying a large box of books. 固定搭配：carry out, carry on。原词carry其它变形：carrier(n.), carriage(n.).

questions.explanation: 考察介词固定搭配 take pride in...，意为“为……感到自豪”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(in)：语境句：Parents often take pride in their children's achievements. 固定搭配：take pride in, be proud of.

questions.explanation: 动词 spreading 后面需要接名词作宾语，表示“传播快乐”，故将 happy 改为 happiness。
questions.supplement: 正确形(happiness)：语境句：Money alone cannot buy true happiness. 固定搭配：bring happiness, spread happiness。原词happy其它变形：happily(adv.), unhappy(adj.), unhappily(adv.).

questions.explanation: song 与 title 之间是被动关系（一首被命名为……的歌），用过去分词短语作后置定语，修饰 a new song。
questions.supplement: 正确形(titled)：语境句：She published a book titled 'The Future of AI'. 固定搭配：be titled, under the title of。原词title其它变形：entitle(v.), entitlement(n.).

questions.explanation: 引导非限制性定语从句，先行词是 the adventurer (指马可·波罗，是人)，在从句中作主语，故填 who。
questions.supplement: 正确形(who)：语境句：My brother, who lives in New York, is visiting us next week. 固定搭配：those who, anyone who.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to know something well
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中系表结构，be动词are配合主语Chinese audience（复数）使用，表示“熟悉”。
vocab_pack.example_en: Students should be familiar with basic grammar rules.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 学生应该熟悉基本语法规则。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Chinese audience are familiar with the pop song Little Bliss

vocab_pack.definition_en: a voice that is like an angel's, very sweet and pure
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 angelic voices 作介词in的宾语，修饰hearing it performed的方式（用天使般的声音演唱）。
vocab_pack.example_en: The choir sang in angelic voices that moved everyone.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 合唱团用天使般的声音演唱，感动了所有人。
vocab_pack.from_passage: hearing it performed in angelic voices

vocab_pack.definition_en: even more emotionally moving
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 made the moment even more touching 为“make + 宾语 + 形容词”结构，touching是形容词作宾语补足语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The second performance was even more touching than the first.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 第二场表演比第一场更加感人。
vocab_pack.from_passage: made the moment even more touching

vocab_pack.definition_en: to give a speech, performance, etc. formally
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 was delivered 是被动语态，一般过去时，delivered是过去分词。表示演出由Italy's Little Choir of Antoniano呈现。
vocab_pack.example_en: The concert will be delivered by a famous orchestra.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这场音乐会将由一个著名乐团演出。
vocab_pack.from_passage: This was delivered by Italy's Little Choir of Antoniano

vocab_pack.definition_en: happening once every year
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 annual 是形容词修饰 New Year concert，表示“一年一度的新年音乐会”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The school holds an annual sports day.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 学校每年举办一次运动会。
vocab_pack.from_passage: their annual New Year concert

vocab_pack.definition_en: to become known widely in a short time
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 spread 是动词过去式（与过去时主语the choir's performance一致），rapidly是副词修饰spread。
vocab_pack.example_en: News of the event spread rapidly through social media.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 事件的消息通过社交媒体迅速传播。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the choir's performance spread rapidly on social media

vocab_pack.definition_en: to get money or something as a result of your work or effort
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 earning 是现在分词作结果状语，表示“获得了超过300万个赞”。主动进行。
vocab_pack.example_en: Her hard work earned her a promotion.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她的努力让她得到了晋升。
vocab_pack.from_passage: earning more than 3 million likes

vocab_pack.definition_en: to attract people's notice
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 have drawn attention 是现在完成时，drawn是过去分词。主语“Their other performances”复数。
vocab_pack.example_en: The bright colors drew everyone's attention.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 鲜艳的颜色引起了所有人的注意。
vocab_pack.from_passage: have all drawn attention online

vocab_pack.definition_en: to come together in large numbers to a place
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 crowd in 是动词短语，主语Chinese listeners复数，一般现在时，表示“蜂拥而至”。
vocab_pack.example_en: Fans crowded in to see the celebrity.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 粉丝们涌进来见那位名人。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Chinese listeners all crowd in

vocab_pack.definition_en: used to introduce two or more alternatives
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 whether to enjoy... or to appreciate... 是“whether to do A or to do B”结构，表达两种目的的选择。
vocab_pack.example_en: I can't decide whether to go or stay.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我无法决定是去还是留。
vocab_pack.from_passage: whether to enjoy their excellent performances or to appreciate perfect pronunciation

vocab_pack.definition_en: flawless way of speaking words
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 perfect pronunciation 是 appreciate 的宾语，表示“欣赏完美的发音”。
vocab_pack.example_en: She practiced hard to achieve perfect pronunciation.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她努力练习以达到完美的发音。
vocab_pack.from_passage: or to appreciate perfect pronunciation

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have a particular function or purpose
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 has served as 是现在完成时，served是过去分词。主语the Little Choir...单数。表示“一直作为”。
vocab_pack.example_en: This room serves as a meeting place.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个房间用作会议室。
vocab_pack.from_passage: has served as a cultural bridge

vocab_pack.definition_en: something that connects two different cultures
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 cultural bridge 作介词as的宾语，表示“作为文化桥梁”。
vocab_pack.example_en: Exchange programs act as a cultural bridge between nations.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 交流项目充当国家间的文化桥梁。
vocab_pack.from_passage: served as a cultural bridge between China and Italy

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause something to go towards a particular place or person
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 bringing 是现在分词，伴随状语，表示“把意大利的热情带到中国”。
vocab_pack.example_en: Her research brought new insights to the problem.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她的研究为这个问题带来了新见解。
vocab_pack.from_passage: bringing Italian passion to China

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: carrying Chinese affection back to Italy
vocab_pack.definition_en: to take something or someone back to a place
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 carrying 是现在分词，伴随状语，表示“把中国的情谊带回意大利”。
vocab_pack.example_en: Please carry these books back to the library.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 请把这些书带回图书馆。
vocab_pack.from_passage: carrying Chinese affection back to Italy

vocab_pack.definition_en: to feel proud about something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 People in Italy generally take pride in... 是一般现在时，take是动词原形(主语复数)。
vocab_pack.example_en: Parents take pride in their children's achievements.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 父母以孩子的成就为荣。
vocab_pack.from_passage: People in Italy generally take pride in the choir's trip to China

vocab_pack.definition_en: to consider something to be something else
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 see it as... 是一般现在时，主语People复数，it指代the choir's trip，as后接名词短语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Many people see learning English as a necessity.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 很多人把学英语视为必要。
vocab_pack.from_passage: see it as an important cultural exchange

vocab_pack.definition_en: sharing ideas, traditions, etc. between cultures
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 an important cultural exchange 是as的宾语补足语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Student exchange programs promote cultural exchange.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 学生交流项目促进文化交流。
vocab_pack.from_passage: an important cultural exchange

vocab_pack.definition_en: to continue doing something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 we can carry on this connection 是情态动词 can + 动词原形 carry on，表示“继续这种联系”。
vocab_pack.example_en: We must carry on with our work despite difficulties.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 尽管有困难，我们必须继续工作。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I hope that we can carry on this connection

vocab_pack.definition_en: to allow something to develop or increase
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 let it grow 是祈使语气，let + 宾语 + 不定式（省略to），grow是原形。
vocab_pack.example_en: Don't intervene; let the plant grow naturally.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 不要干预，让植物自然生长。
vocab_pack.from_passage: let it grow

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make happiness widely felt
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 spreading happiness 是现在分词作伴随状语，表示“通过我们的音乐传播快乐”。
vocab_pack.example_en: Volunteers aim to spread happiness in communities.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 志愿者旨在社区中传播快乐。
vocab_pack.from_passage: spreading happiness through our music

vocab_pack.definition_en: as a way of remembering and honoring someone
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 showed a new song titled... in memory of the adventurer，介词短语作目的状语。
vocab_pack.example_en: They built a statue in memory of the hero.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他们建了一座雕像以纪念英雄。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a new song titled Marco Polo's Magical Journey in memory of the adventurer

vocab_pack.definition_en: to do the early work that makes something later possible
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 laid the groundwork 是过去时，laid是lay的过去式，主语who指代adventurer。表示“为友谊打下基础”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The scientist laid the groundwork for future research.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这位科学家为未来的研究打下了基础。
vocab_pack.from_passage: who laid the groundwork for China-Italy friendship

vocab_pack.definition_en: over, exceeding
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 more than 3 million likes 表示数量超过300万，作定语修饰likes。
vocab_pack.example_en: She has more than ten years of experience.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她有超过十年的经验。
vocab_pack.from_passage: earning more than 3 million likes

vocab_pack.definition_en: resembling an angel, extremely beautiful or pure
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 angelic 是形容词修饰 voices，表示“天使般的声音”。
vocab_pack.example_en: Her angelic smile lit up the room.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她天使般的微笑照亮了房间。
vocab_pack.from_passage: angelic voices

vocab_pack.definition_en: causing feelings of sympathy or emotion
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 made the moment even more touching，touching是形容词作宾语补足语，表达“使那一刻更加感人”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The movie's ending was very touching.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 电影的结尾非常感人。
vocab_pack.from_passage: even more touching

vocab_pack.definition_en: a person who is in charge of an organization or activity
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 director of Antoniano 是同位语，说明Giampaolo Cavalli的身份。
vocab_pack.example_en: He was appointed director of the institute.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他被任命为研究所主任。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Giampaolo Cavalli, director of Antoniano

vocab_pack.definition_en: to hold and move something to a place
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 carrying 是现在分词，与bringing并列，伴随状语。表示“把中国的情谊带回意大利”。
vocab_pack.example_en: She carried the baby carefully.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她小心地抱着婴儿。
vocab_pack.from_passage: carrying Chinese affection back to Italy

vocab_pack.definition_en: a relationship or link between things
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 this connection 指代前文提到的文化桥梁关系，是动词carry on的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: There is a strong connection between exercise and health.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 锻炼和健康之间有密切联系。
vocab_pack.from_passage: carry on this connection

vocab_pack.definition_en: a feeling of liking or love
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 Chinese affection 是动词carrying的宾语，表示“中国的喜爱之情”。
vocab_pack.example_en: She has deep affection for her hometown.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她对家乡有深厚的感情。
vocab_pack.from_passage: carrying Chinese affection back to Italy

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have a particular title
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 a new song titled... 是过去分词短语作后置定语，相当于which is titled。
vocab_pack.example_en: The book is titled 'The Great Gatsby'.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这本书名为《了不起的盖茨比》。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a new song titled Marco Polo's Magical Journey

vocab_pack.definition_en: preliminary work that provides the basis for something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 laid the groundwork 是固定短语，groundwork是名词，表示“打下基础”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The team did the groundwork for the project.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 团队为这个项目做了基础工作。
vocab_pack.from_passage: laid the groundwork for China-Italy friendship
